slides.title: The catch
items: Pain picks the problem. It does not secure the product.
AI code added security flaws in 45% of tests (Veracode).
In banking, health and energy, that decides trust.

slides.title: Let the people with the pain build the first version.
slides.sub: Then bring in the people who know what must never break.
slides.sign: I design products that cannot afford to fail.
